genesis.17.p1.b1.text: When Abram was ninety-nine years old, the LORD appeared to him …

genesis.17.p1.b2.text: “I am God Almighty. Walk before Me and be blameless. I will establish My covenant between Me and you, and I will multiply you exceedingly.”

genesis.17.p2.b4.text: “As for Me, this is My covenant with you: You will be the father of many nations.

genesis.17.p2.b5.text: No longer will you be called Abram, but your name will be Abraham, for I have made you a father of many nations.

genesis.17.p2.b6.text: I will make you exceedingly fruitful; I will make nations of you, and kings will descend from you.

genesis.17.p2.b7.text: And to you and your descendants I will give the land where you are residing—all the land of Canaan—as an eternal possession; and I will be their God.”

genesis.17.p3.b8.text: “You must keep My covenant—you and your descendants in the generations after you.”

genesis.17.p3.b9.text: “… Every male among you must be circumcised. … this will be a sign of the covenant between Me and you.”

genesis.17.p3.b10.text: “Generation after generation, every male must be circumcised when he is eight days old …”

genesis.17.p3.b11.text: “… My covenant in your flesh will be an everlasting covenant.”

genesis.17.p4.b12.text: “As for Sarai your wife, do not call her Sarai, for her name is to be Sarah.”

genesis.17.p4.b13.text: “And I will bless her and will surely give you a son by her. … she will be the mother of nations …”

genesis.17.p4.b14.text: Abraham fell facedown. Then he laughed …

genesis.17.p4.b15.text: “Can a child be born to a man who is a hundred years old? Can Sarah give birth at the age of ninety?”

genesis.17.p5.b16.text: “O that Ishmael might live under Your blessing!”

genesis.17.p5.b17.text: “Your wife Sarah will indeed bear you a son, and you are to name him Isaac.”

genesis.17.p5.b18.text: “As for Ishmael, I have heard you … He will become the father of twelve rulers, and I will make him into a great nation.”

genesis.17.p5.b19.text: When He had finished speaking with Abraham, God went up from him.

genesis.17.p6.b20.text: On that very day Abraham … just as God had told him.

genesis.17.p6.b21.text: … took his son Ishmael and all those born in his household or purchased with his money … and he circumcised them …

genesis.17.p6.b22.text: So Abraham was ninety-nine years old when he was circumcised, and his son Ishmael was thirteen;
